file_reviews.assessment: Full file reviewed as checkout hygiene. Ignores virtual environments, caches, build products, secrets paths and workflow output; tracked files remain in the pinned inventory. It supplies no mathematical result.

Full file reviewed as repository metadata: Apache License 2.0 template with an unfilled copyright appendix. It supplies no mathematical premise, evidence of correctness or original authorship. No legal interpretation or completeness-of-attribution claim made.

Full package/dependency/test/lint configuration reviewed. Default pytest paths cover only pfp_lab/tests and governance/tools/tests; this is not a test census for PFP, EIS, PCIV or OPERADS. Explicit setuptools package list includes PFP/Lab and selected ops packages but not eis, pciv or operads. No new dependency installation or wheel build performed.

Full JSON Schema reviewed. Discriminated moves, forbidden extra fields and finite array bounds describe structural admissibility; name/rational, graph endpoint/uniqueness and positive-weight predicates are absent from generated schema. Four bad-carrier/value examples pass JSON Schema while runtime validators refuse them.

Full receipt schema reviewed. Requires SHA-shaped digest, input, verdicts and final state but does not validate their consistency or authenticity. Resealed invented final state passes schema/model while current-core replay rejects it.

Full source reviewed. BeforeValidator adapters and ScenarioIn graph validator impose stronger predicates than JSON Schema. Shallow frozen models contain mutable CutIn.section dictionaries; cached get_pack returns the same object, allowing in-process caller mutation to contaminate later lookups.

Full source reviewed. Receipt digest binds fields and verification recomputes current-core outputs. Rehashed invented final state is refused; invented core_version is accepted if present current-core outputs match. Replay therefore does not authenticate claimed historic implementation version. Canonicalization cross-language standard equivalence was not independently verified in this slice.

claims.statement: Schema acceptance, runtime admission and current-core replay are three different predicates. The selected synthetic examples separate them.
dependencies: A semantics-level certificate requires an independently adequate target predicate and a correct checker beyond JSON shape.
Historic execution authenticity requires source/runtime identity evidence beyond a self-recomputed receipt digest.

claims.statement: Default pytest success and installed package support cover a declared subset of this checkout, not the entire four-system estate.
dependencies: Any full-repository test claim needs an explicit test census, environments and invocation set.

findings.statement: Frozen cached pack models expose mutable nested section dictionaries. A public caller changes a returned CutIn.section value without validation, and the next get_pack call exposes the mutation.
findings.scope: Reproduced in a single public process and restored before exit; no source edits. It does not demonstrate a remote endpoint mutation path.

findings.statement: Generated JSON Schemas admit cases that stronger runtime validators refuse; schema-validity is not carrier/rational correctness.
findings.scope: Four synthetic invalid instances; positive and unknown-field controls included.

findings.statement: Receipt verification replays against the current core and does not authenticate the declared historic core_version.
findings.scope: This is the current function contract, not proof that receipts were forged historically.

limits: No package install, wheel build, network, providers, protected benchmark access or full-suite invocation.
Runtime validators were exercised on the selected public cases; complete admission/governor/graph implementations are outside this incremental slice.
No claim about legal licensing sufficiency or history authenticity.
